blocks.text: The missing partitions leave the pet’s outline briefly searching for a room that is gone.
Location: Shelter Orison, the Vanishing Shelter
Appearance: Godot draws three translucent copies of the current pet frame in different directions. Reduced motion holds them still.
Care: Targeted chronic treatment; rest alone does not cure the condition.
Story connection: A future rescue could distinguish shelter memories from navigable rooms.
New gameplay lore; future hook is hypothetical. Location status remains: Story-established. Its internal geography is only partly recoverable.
